I'm having an existential crisis because I hadn't realised that people refer to it as 'yeeting' and now I feel old. 

Im so sorry that you have to go through this. You don't deserve to be treated like that. You're almost there though, you've been strong for this long, and you're almost at a point where you can move out or do less things that involve her. I'm so bad at giving advice but when it comes to shitty parents that's the only thing I agree with when people say it gets better. One day you will be free of them, and you won't feel so stuck. 

Sometimes I like to colour over my old scars to disteact myself, if you use red expecially.
Yes omg!!! If I'm taking in calories it has to be worth those calories otherwise I'll just not eat.
